<infobox theme="Title">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="establishedby"><label>Established by</label></data>	
        <data source="dateestablished"><label>Date established</label></data>		
        <data source="datesuspended"><label>Date suspended</label></data>	
        <data source="datereestablished"><label>Date reestablished</label></data>	
        <data source="dateabolished"><label>Date abolished</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Organizational information</header>
        <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
        <data source="organization"><label>Organization</label></data>
        <data source="type"><label>Position type</label></data>
        <data source="term"><label>Term length</label></data>		
        <data source="powers"><label>Powers</label></data>
        <data source="duties"><label>Duties</label></data>	
    </group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:TitleOrPosition|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

===Usage instructions===
Paste the following code at the beginning of the article, filing all relevant fields. If a field doesn't apply, just leave it blank.

<pre><nowiki>{{TitleOrPosition
|image=
|name=
|establishedby=
|dateestablished=
|datesuspended=
|datereestablished=
|dateabolished=
|government=
|organization=
|type=
|term=
|powers=
|duties=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
